title: The Social Web Suite – Social Media Auto Post, Social Media Auto Publish plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic…
description: The Social Web Suite WordPress plugin (up to version 4.1.12) contains a generic SQL Injection vulnerability via the 'exclude_posts' parameter. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to append arbitrary SQL queries to extract sensitive database information. The vulnerability is exacerbated by a bypassable HMAC authentication mechanism on fresh installations where the secret key is not yet generated.
